dataset: USFIMR flood-inundation extent — Brazos River near Richmond, Texas
provider: University of Alabama, Surface Dynamics Modeling Lab (SDML)

event.name: 2016 Brazos River flood (late May – early June 2016)
event.note: the image is three days BEFORE this peak, so it is a mid-rise observation

stage_at_acquisition_note: the catalog does not publish the acquisition time; the LAYER does, in its own attributes (Flood_Date + Start_Time = 2016-05-30T00:26:20Z), and the validation pins the comparison to the gauge reading at that instant. This band is the fetch-time fallback, and the validation reports the sensitivity to the choice
nature: water edge read from one radar image — not a surveyed maximum, not an event peak, and subject to the usual SAR failure modes (vegetation and smooth open water both backscatter oddly; a wind-roughened surface can read as land)
